title: Analysis plan of the C1 blind listening pack of Run C (exploratory)

pack.pack: c1_blind_pack.zip: 24 pairs, written by experiments/e9_clock_replicate/package_c1.py in Run C
pack.key: runs/colab_l4_runC_20261031/c1_blind_key_SEALED.json in the owner's private repository ninondev/project-ryuichi, added at commit f29df5d1335f185d877e505f75fa16cacf2582e6

sections.text: The C1 pack is exploratory (addendum 4, section package): its result never changes C1's registered verdict, 'Clock helps, capability not reached'. This plan fixes its analysis before anyone rates it. It is the analysis of the B2 pack in listening_plan.json, applied to the C1 pack with the same code (analyze_ratings.py in its 'b2' mode, with --scores results/gpu_run4/c1_result.json). S* is the clock recipe and S*_b0 the same melody guide without the clock.

A rater of the C1 pack confirms, in one line when handing in a sheet, that they have not seen the C1 key, have not heard any labelled demo clip of Run C (in the result package or in the folder of demo clips sent apart from it), and have not read Run C's per-clip results (results/gpu_run4/ or the same files in the result package; their transcripts, read with the demo list, tell which clip of a pair has the clock). A 'no', or no confirmation by closing, excludes the rater from the C1 analysis. listening_plan.json's other rules on raters, sheets and formats apply unchanged. A rater may rate the B2 pack and the C1 pack; the two analyses are reported apart.

listening_plan.json's closing section applies unchanged to the C1 sheets, with its own exclusions file (exclusions_c1.json) and its own deadline: ratings close when the owner says no more C1 sheets are coming, at the latest on 2026-11-30 at 23:59 UTC.

listening_plan.json's b2_test section, unchanged: the centred conditional randomization test over the side vectors with the key's number of pairs with S* on side A, per question, with the labels 'listeners favour the clock', 'listeners favour no clock' and 'no clear preference' at p < 0.05, two sided, and no correction for the two questions.

listening_plan.json's b2_report section, unchanged, with the machine scores taken from results/gpu_run4/c1_result.json: Whisper word recall, CTC word recall on the mix, and NPA on the separated vocal. CTC word recall on the separated vocal is not part of the agreement report. analyze_ratings.py names listening_plan.json as its plan in the output; for the C1 pack the plan is this file.

The C1 sides came from the operating system's random source when Run C packaged its clips. The key and its salt are in the private repository at the path and commit in pack; the published fingerprint is sha256 of the salt file's 64 ASCII hex characters (no newline) followed by the key file's bytes. The owner uploaded the key and the pack to the agents on 2026-10-31; the key's contents were shown to the agents when it arrived, and an agent opened it again to audit the pack (pair order, that every clip matches its run, and that nothing in the files shows a side). Facts from that audit, the side balance among them, appeared in the agents' working output, which the owner can open; the test does not depend on a rater not knowing the side balance. The owner was asked not to open the key file; whether it was opened before the upload is asked at closing and recorded. File metadata in the zip of 140 demo clips that the owner sent apart from the result package shows that two labelled demo clips of item c1t00, which is not in the pack, were accessed by an application on the owner's computer on 2026-10-31 (one carries a last-opened time of 05:01Z); the owner says no demo clip was listened to, only moved. Both facts go into the closing record. The agents also ran the analysis once on the real key with a sheet that answers 'same' everywhere, with the code registered here, to check it, and deleted the output. No output of analyze_ratings.py with the real key is shared before the key is published, because each output holds the key's sha256. No rating of the C1 pack existed when this plan was written.

The analysis writes results/listening/c1_ratings.json. README.md and LOG.md report the labels, D, the centred margin, m, the p values and the counts. The key and its salt are published with the results. A change to this plan after this file is committed goes into a new file.
